description: Use this when something sounded wrong, a tool was confusing, or a feature is missing: send the team a short note (up to 20000 characters; longer in parts; if limited, moose@moosetracker.app). Quiet and occasional; never nag the user.

message.description: What happened or what is needed; no personal details. Up to 20000 characters; longer reports go in parts (ref, part, parts).

mtl.description: Optional: the song or sound involved, only if relevant

ref.description: Optional label shared by every part of one long report; parts with the same ref count as one submission

name: feedback
title: Send feedback
